text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc said Monday it knew of no basis for rumors of an impending offer to acquire the company.

Carter-Wallace said it decided to violate its own policy of not commenting on rumors because of the unusually heavy trading volume in its stock following a published report that a bid would soon be forthcoming.

Business Week magazine reported in its May 26 issue that a British maker of packaged goods foods and detergents would soon offer $24 per share for Carter-Wallace. Business Week did not name the British firm.
Carter-Wallace shares, which opened at a year-high of 17-7/8, fell 2-3/8 or 13 percent to 15-1/2 in afternoon trading, the steepest decline on the New York Stock Exchange in percentage terms.
